fusions.name: Sharp Report
fusions.desc: Fires a weighted link at the first enemy it meets that deals 38 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Grapeshot
fusions.desc: Fires 4 linked slugs in a fan out to 6 tiles, each dealing 6 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Swivel Mount
fusions.desc: Mounts a gun on a chained stand where you stand for 14 seconds. It fires at an enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hangfire Recoil
fusions.desc: When a run of strikes passes without a critical hit, your critical chance rises 40% for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
